evals.prompt: Run /rui-report-self-test on the current directory and open the report.
evals.expected_output: An HTML report at docs/reports/self-test/index.html with six self-test scenes (post-init-full-self-check, pre-commit-incremental-self-check, doc-code-consistency, security-surface-regression, cross-story-integration-regression, third-party-framework-service), a composite score gauge, and a per-scene verdict (pass/partial/fail).
expectations: docs/reports/self-test/data.js contains window.REPORT_DATA.scenes with exactly 6 entries
Each scene has section0..section4 plus verdict and coverage
Composite score is computed and rendered in the score gauge

evals.prompt: Run /rui-report-self-test on a Node.js project with vitest and a CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: A self-test report where scene 1 (post-init-full-self-check) and scene 2 (pre-commit-incremental-self-check) should pass (vitest detected, CLAUDE.md present, README likely present).

evals.prompt: Run /rui-report-self-test on an empty directory (no source files after exclusions).
evals.expected_output: The report still renders all six scenes, each with a # TODO marker and a 'fail' verdict (or low coverage).

evals.prompt: Run /rui-report-self-test on a project with broken markdown links in docs/.
evals.expected_output: Scene 5 (cross-story-integration-regression) reports a non-zero brokenLinks count and the per-scene verdict reflects that.
expectations: scene 5 verdict is not 'pass' when brokenLinks > 0
The §3 Test Report rows map 1:1 to §1 steps

evals.prompt: Run /rui-report-self-test --no-merge and verify that docs/self-test/ is not modified.
evals.expected_output: The report is generated at docs/reports/self-test/, but no markdown files are written under docs/self-test/scene-N-<slug>/index.md.

evals.prompt: Run /rui-report-self-test on a project that uses innerHTML and has a .env file.
evals.expected_output: Scene 4 (security-surface-regression) surfaces the dangerous call and the .env file. The verdict is 'partial' or 'fail' depending on count.
expectations: dangerousCalls contains an entry for innerHTML
